title: LB Omnichord Gamma9001-first kit-independent drum fills matched to refreshed activity grooves

repository_contract.design_status: canonical Gamma9001-first runtime fill catalogue; source-audited and performance-balanced 2026-09-05

design_contract.kit_independence: Events contain only tick, logical role and velocity; kit choice never changes timing.
design_contract.start_rule: A fill is queued at one of its 1-based allowed_start_beats. Beat numbering uses the written meter denominator: quarter-note counts in /4 and eighth-note counts in /8.
design_contract.syncopation_rule: A fill whose audible first hit is syncopated contains an explicit leading_rest. Its technical start remains on an allowed whole meter-count boundary.
design_contract.duration_rule: duration_beats includes leading_rest and all audible fill events.
design_contract.resolution_rule: Resolution hints use logical roles only; concrete sounds belong to instrument profiles.
design_contract.amy_48ppq_rule: All event ticks are even at 96 PPQ and exactly convertible to AMY 48 PPQ.
design_contract.activity_coupling: Every fill starts from the final matching window of the current level-3 refreshed groove, then overlays genre-specific transition vocabulary.
design_contract.bar_resolution_rule: Every allowed fill start makes the complete fill end at the next written bar boundary; the following groove downbeat owns the resolution.
design_contract.gamma9001_policy: Gamma9001 is the musical quality reference; fills may use its tom, ride/bell, side-stick, electronic and patch-390 Latin percussion vocabulary.
design_contract.tiny_policy: Tiny resolves all logical roles for tests/compatibility; reduced sounds are accepted degradation and never constrain authoring.
design_contract.continuation_policy: Continuation roles are style-specific and intersected with roles actually present in the refreshed activity catalogue.
design_contract.start_rotation_policy: Each fill has one phrase-ending start derived from its authoritative duration and written meter. Runtime fill selection supplies variety without mid-bar start rotation.
design_contract.instrumentation_diversity_rule: Fill event timing is kit-independent, but F1-F5 deliberately use different logical orchestration. Gamma9001 may additionally select a fill-specific realization profile; Tiny remains a compatibility fallback.
design_contract.velocity_balance_rule: Authored fill velocities preserve their internal dynamic contour after a proportional 0.82 trim; the catalogue maximum is 103 so transitions remain energetic without defaulting to near-maximum velocity.
design_contract.rhythmic_diversity_rule: Within every rhythm, F1-F5 have distinct duration/onset contours as well as distinct logical orchestration; straight and triplet grids remain stylistically intact.

logical_roles.low_primary: Primary low-frequency pulse/anchor; usually a bass drum but kit mapping owns the sound.
logical_roles.section_accent: Strong bright accent marking a structural point; not a mandatory crash sample.
logical_roles.timeline_primary: Clave/bell/timeline function for styles whose identity needs a repeating timeline.
logical_roles.hand_accent: Hand/electronic accent function such as clap/cowbell depending on kit/style.
logical_roles.electronic_detail: Short synthetic/electronic detail or stutter function.
